On November 17th, AI+ consumer robotics company Ling Universe announced the completion of a 200 million yuan Pre-A series funding round, with investors including Didi Chuxing, Lakala, Shanghai International, Guotai Haitong, and GF Xinde. This follows a previous round last year backed by capital from 37 Interactive Entertainment, SenseTime, and Linear Capital.

excerpt_i18n.en:
On November 18, Leiphone reported the launch of Zebra Spoken English, the world's first one-on-one AI tutor product for children aged 6–12. It features a "superhuman AI tutor" that provides personalized, full-English instruction, ensuring every child has a dedicated AI tutor. This release marks the transition of large AI models from general exploration to practical application in specific industries, representing the first truly industrialized AI Agent in education. 

The "superhuman tutor" addresses common challenges in children's oral English learning, such as difficulty finding and scheduling human tutors, inconsistent expertise, and children's reluctance to speak. AI Agents excel with superior memory and storage, recalling every moment of a child's lessons—from speaking performance and knowledge accumulation to unique habits, interests, and personality traits. Zebra Spoken English achieves this breakthrough by focusing intensely on the narrow scenario of one-on-one children's oral practice. This requires the AI to possess multiple capabilities: first, speech recognition that understands children, deciphering non-standard accents, fragmented sentences, and erratic thinking; second, teaching logic that effectively educates, supported by algorithms integrating second language acquisition theory, child cognitive psychology, and extensive teaching cases.

excerpt_i18n.en:
Gyges Labs recently completed its Pre-A+ funding round, with investments from Granite Asia and CanCan Capital. Following the international success of their jointly launched AI glasses, Halliday, the new funds will primarily support the expansion of a more diverse range of "superhuman gear" (AI wearable products), with related new products set to debut gradually starting in early 2026.

Unlike approaches that aim to replace humans with AI, Gyges Labs is an AI wearable technology company dedicated to "enabling everyone to become superhuman." The company operates globally, with its headquarters in Singapore, software and AI teams based in Silicon Valley, USA, and leverages China's supply chain advantages, featuring unique technologies such as advanced optics and active AI.

Just as Iron Man and Batman's gear empowers ordinary individuals, Gyges Labs believes that applying AI to wearable products to let humans harness AI, rather than directly providing AI with limbs, makes humans more irreplaceable.

Luo Tingxia, founding partner of CanCan Capital, stated: "As a next-generation investment firm focused on technology and consumer sectors, we are committed to discovering and supporting companies that define the future. Gyges Labs perfectly embodies this vision. While the smart glasses industry is still exploring forms, they have already positioned themselves as the gateway to next-generation human-computer interaction through their forward-looking insights into 'invisibility' and 'proactivity.' Their team demonstrates exceptional product definition capabilities and pragmatism.
excerpt_i18n.es: Gyges Labs ha completado recientemente su ronda de financiación Pre-A+, con inversores Granite Asia y Brilliant Capital. Tras el lanzamiento conjunto de las gafas de IA Halliday, que causaron sensación en el mercado internacional, estos fondos se destinarán principalmente a expandir una gama más diversa de "equipamiento sobrehumano" (productos vestibles de IA), con nuevos modelos previstos para debutar gradualmente desde principios de 2026. Convertir a las personas en superhumanos podría ser el enfoque correcto para el paradigma de interacción humano-máquina. A diferencia de los valores que buscan reemplazar a los humanos con IA, Gyges Labs es una empresa tecnológica de wearables de IA dedicada a "permitir que todos se conviertan en superhumanos".
